title: Debo Ray unveils a bold new musical identity with self-titled debut album
htmlContent:
Debo Ray is making waves in the music scene with her debut album, "Debo Ray." This impressive collection features 10 songs that highlight her incredible vocal talents and emotional depth. Produced by Grammy winner Prince Charles Alexander and co-written with Jerry Velona, the album showcases Debo's wide-ranging musical style, blending genres like opera, R&B, rock, and even metal.

After years of performing with various bands, Debo took a brave step in 2022 to focus on her original music, sharing her personal story through her songs. The result is an album that mixes sounds from classic R&B and gospel to pop and hip-hop, offering a fresh feel that stands out in today's crowded music market. Standout tracks from the album include the catchy "Time With You" and the smooth "Feeling Lucky."

https://open.spotify.com/album/5KbLcBO6AYdoI378CwfA2v

Both songs combine thoughtful lyrics with great music, perfectly capturing Debo's unique style. With a total playtime of just under 36 minutes, every song leaves a powerful impression, proving that Debo Ray has truly found her place in the music world. This debut is a powerful introduction to an exciting new artist. If you're a long time fan of her singing or hearing her for the first time, this album will surely leave a lasting impact.
